stickers.caption: 回家过年
stickers.usage_note: 通知出发；不能回家的人可跳过
stickers.pose: Walking happily with a small ochre rolling suitcase and a plain red scarf, glancing forward eagerly, one wing waving goodbye.

stickers.caption: 一路平安
stickers.usage_note: 回应行程，表达牵挂
stickers.pose: Standing warmly, waving one wing toward a departing friend, other wing holding a small red heart close, calm caring smile.

stickers.caption: 到家啦
stickers.usage_note: 发送到达消息，正文补充地点
stickers.pose: Sitting relieved beside a tiny suitcase, wings thrown open joyfully, a single simple red-roof house icon above one shoulder.

stickers.caption: 年货备齐
stickers.usage_note: 分享采购进度，不炫耀消费金额
stickers.pose: Proudly carrying one compact basket containing two mandarins and a small red gift parcel, cheerful determined expression.

stickers.caption: 接福啦
stickers.usage_note: 接祝福；不宣称福字一律倒贴
stickers.pose: Reaching both wings forward to welcome a small upright red diamond paper bearing one correct gold Chinese character 福, delighted welcoming eyes. The 福 character is upright, not rotated.

stickers.caption: 开饭啦
stickers.usage_note: 邀请入席；不以单一食品代表全国
stickers.pose: Leaning excitedly over one small steaming cream rice bowl, holding one small spoon in a wing, eager open beak, inviting gesture with other wing. No crowded table.

stickers.caption: 年年有余
stickers.usage_note: 借鱼余谐音表达富足
stickers.pose: Hugging one plump stylized golden-red carp gently, beaming smile, fish alive and friendly, simple curved fish shape not a food platter.

stickers.caption: 新年快乐
stickers.usage_note: 可搭配对方称呼使用
stickers.pose: Jumping joyfully with wings raised high, one small red lantern above shoulder, two tiny gold sparkles, wide cheerful eyes.

stickers.caption: 给您拜年
stickers.usage_note: 您用于表达敬意；正文可补具体称呼
stickers.pose: Facing front with both rounded wings clasped together neatly at chest in a warm respectful New Year greeting, slight bow, attentive open amber eyes.

stickers.caption: 身体健康
stickers.usage_note: 祝愿而非功效承诺
stickers.pose: Holding a small smooth red blessing pouch with a simple gold circle, raising other wing in a gentle supportive gesture, calm reassuring smile, no medical symbols.

stickers.caption: 阖家幸福
stickers.usage_note: 祝福整个家庭
stickers.pose: Wings making a broad embracing curve around one little cream house with a red roof and tiny heart above it, smiling crescent eyes, sense of home and warmth.

stickers.caption: 恭喜发财
stickers.usage_note: 通用吉语，不预言财富
stickers.pose: Happily presenting one large rounded gold yuanbao ingot with both wings, proud upright pose and delighted amber eyes, no coin shower.

stickers.caption: 红包拿来
stickers.usage_note: 仅熟人玩笑，避免对客户长辈催索
stickers.pose: Leaning forward with both wings cupped open playfully, cheeky bashful smile and tilted head, a tiny plain red envelope icon above shoulder; affectionate joking request, never angry or demanding.

stickers.caption: 谢谢红包
stickers.usage_note: 具体致谢，不代替必要的人情回应
stickers.pose: Holding a plain red envelope to chest with both wings, making a small grateful bow, bright tender amber eyes and subtle blush.

stickers.caption: 心意收到
stickers.usage_note: 不限定金钱，可接一句祝福
stickers.pose: Eyes softly smiling, both wings holding one small warm red heart, restrained grateful pose, no envelope, no money.

stickers.caption: 同喜同喜
stickers.usage_note: 来回祝福；不回应不幸或丧事
stickers.pose: Facing viewer, one wing at chest and other wing extended back toward viewer in reciprocal greeting, warm knowing wink, two small golden sparkles.

stickers.caption: 来串门啦
stickers.usage_note: 先在正文约好时间，不表示未经约定到访
stickers.pose: Stepping in eagerly while carrying a compact red gift bag with a small visible mandarin, one wing raised in greeting, friendly open eyes.

stickers.caption: 吃好喝好
stickers.usage_note: 热情招待；画茶不劝酒
stickers.pose: Offers a tea cup and a plate with two mandarin oranges; warm hospitality without alcohol.

stickers.caption: 真吃不下了
stickers.usage_note: 自嘲吃饱，避免羞辱体型
stickers.pose: Sitting back with a comically full round belly, one wing patting belly and the other gently making a stop gesture, sheepish closed-eye smile and one small sweat drop, no disgust.

stickers.caption: 先过个好年
stickers.usage_note: 不针对婚育身份；严肃事项另说清
stickers.pose: Relaxed seated owl holding a small teacup, other wing gently open in a friendly pause gesture, serene humorous smile, no mocking or angry expression.

stickers.caption: 接财神
stickers.usage_note: 地方性民俗，不写成全国统一日期
stickers.pose: Dressed in a modest festive red vest and a small simple traditional red prosperity cap that keeps both ear tufts visible, lifting one gold ingot with joyous wide eyes; friendly symbolic festival costume, no altar.

stickers.caption: 开工大吉
stickers.usage_note: 不绑定初几或法定假期日期
stickers.pose: Sitting upright behind a tiny plain dark blue laptop with a small red ribbon tied around its side, energetic wing salute and confident bright eyes.

stickers.caption: 团团圆圆
stickers.usage_note: 圆子表达团圆；不混同汤圆元宵工艺
stickers.pose: Holding one cream bowl of three round white tangyuan balls with a small red lantern beside shoulder, tender crescent-eye smile, no chopsticks piercing food.

stickers.caption: 下次再聚
stickers.usage_note: 温暖告别与下次约定
stickers.pose: Standing beside a small suitcase and waving one wing goodbye, other wing resting at chest, affectionate bittersweet smile without crying, a tiny red heart beside face.
